title: Initiative Tracker Boss Encounter Pace
dataSources: Character sheets (`rpg:character`), VTT sessions (`rpg:session`), initiative rounds (`rpg:initiative`), encounters (`rpg:combat`), campaign ops (`rpg:ops`).
app: Tabletop campaign telemetry — D&D Beyond character exports, Roll20 session logs, initiative trackers, and campaign asset checklists — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rpg:initiative boss_name=* round_duration_sec=*
| stats avg(round_duration_sec) as avg_round_duration_sec, count as events by boss_name
| sort - avg_round_duration_sec
description: Shows average round duration seconds by boss encounter for boss fights.
value: Average round duration seconds by boss encounter helps compare boss fights across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `round_duration_sec` on `rpg:initiative` events and normalize `boss_name` so Splunk can summarize performance by boss encounter.
visualization: Bar chart of average round duration seconds by boss encounter.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals the average round duration seconds for each boss encounter so you can see what works best for boss fights.
